Celebrating Two Decades of American Craftsmanship Nichole Grant | April 15, 2025 Sherrill Manufacturing recently marked a major milestone-its 20th anniversary! The celebration brought together employees, vendors, and everyone who has played a role in the company's success. And, of course, there was cake! Greg Owens and Matt Roberts cut the cake at Sherrill Manufacturing's 20th Anniversary Celebration. A Look Back: The Journey of Sherrill Manufacturing The company was founded on March 21, 2005, at a critical time when Oneida Limited was preparing to shut down its operations.
